adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that `addMembers` action at line 64 calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"))` and `removeMember` action at line 53 calls `self.get("model").removeMember(member)` without handling the returned promises. Looking at the model code in group.js, both `addMembers` and `removeMember` return promises from Discourse.ajax calls. If these fail, there's no error handling - no catch/rejection handler, no user feedback. In contrast, the `save` action in the same controller (lines 67-84) properly handles the promise with `.then()` and `.finally()` callbacks including `self.set('disableSave', false)`. This is a real defect where API failures would silently fail without user notification.
